features.title: Capture anything and let it sort itself
features.summary: One capture box and one agent tool take free text; kind, title, tags and links (items, threads, jj revisions, branches, URLs) are derived from it, and an agent capture links its thread and project.
failureModes: An unknown prefix stays in the title and the item becomes a task.
A storage write failure is logged and the in-memory item stays readable.

verification.testName: derives kind, title, body, tags and links from free text
makes a trailing question mark a question and keeps unknown prefixes in the title
links an agent capture to its thread and project, and lists newest activity first
continues ids after a Host restart

features.title: Feed ordered by activity, with idle items sinking
features.summary: The feed lists pinned items, then newest activity first. Status chips narrow the feed and the Items list to one status or several at once. Freshness is derived on read: notes go dormant after 14 days, other open items after 30, idle in-progress work is flagged stale, closed items archive after 7 days; any touch revives an item.
failureModes: Dormant and archived items stay in search and backlinks; only the default feed hides them.

verification.testName: shows every status until a chip is picked, then only the picked ones
lets notes sink after two weeks and tasks after a month, but never pinned items
flags idle in-progress work as stale instead of hiding it, and archives closed items after a week
hides dormant items from the feed until something touches them

features.title: Board, links, backlinks and history
features.summary: A board groups the same items into Inbox, Todo, In progress, Done and Dropped columns in that order. An item's detail edits its fields, links it to threads, revisions, branches, workspaces, URLs or other items, lists the items that link to it, and shows every event with its actor; fields the user set are recorded as theirs.
failureModes: An unknown item id answers not-found without writing.

verification.testName: records who moved an item and which fields the user owns
answers backlinks for items and for any linked target

features.title: Select items in ranges and batch-edit them
features.summary: The Items table supports click-to-open, Shift-click ranges, Cmd/Ctrl-click additive toggles, select-all-visible, and batch status, kind and pin updates.
failureModes: A range uses the current visible item order and falls back to the target if its anchor is no longer visible.

verification.testName: toggles non-adjacent items without changing the remaining selection
adds the inclusive range in either direction and preserves additive selections

features.title: Triage new items automatically
features.summary: With autoTriage on, each capture is triaged in the background: Jev answers whether it is work to do and whether it repeats the closest open item, a configured cheap model proposes kind, status, title, tags and duplicates using the user's past corrections as examples. A confident proposal applies as `system` and skips fields the user set by hand; a hesitant one waits on the item to be accepted or dismissed.
failureModes: A failing or missing Jev key or model is skipped; the item stays in the Inbox.
A model answer with invalid fields keeps only the valid ones; a duplicate it was not shown is ignored.

externalDependencies.boundary: Optional POST to api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone with the item text, behind jevEnabled and TYPESAFE_API_KEY; any failure is skipped.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: An injected jev function answers fixed probabilities in src/triage.test.ts.

externalDependencies.boundary: Optional cheap-model call through the DSH llm service on triageProvider/triageModel; the answer is decoded with a schema and invalid fields dropped.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: An injected complete function returns fixed text in src/triage.test.ts.

verification.testName: moves work out of the inbox with Jev alone and reports its confidence
turns a plain capture Jev reads as knowledge into a note
flags the closest open item as a duplicate when Jev says it is the same work
takes the model answer, dropping invalid fields and duplicates it was not shown
lowers confidence when Jev and the model disagree on the kind
proposes nothing when every service fails or nothing would change
learns from items whose applied triage the user corrected by hand
applies automatic triage without touching fields the user set by hand
keeps a hesitant proposal until the user accepts it, then treats its values as theirs
dismisses a proposal without changing the item

features.title: Move items from thread and revision signals
features.summary: A user message mentioning b:<n> links that thread and starts the item; a revision on main whose description says Closes/Fixes/Resolves b:<n> links the revision and finishes it. Signals only move forward and never over a status the user set by hand.
failureModes: A repository without jj or a main bookmark is skipped.
An unchanged main costs one read-only jj call and is not rescanned.

externalDependencies.boundary: Read-only `jj log --ignore-working-copy` on main in the repositories open items name (and revisionRepositories), bounded output and a 20s timeout.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: src/signals.test.ts runs the shipped template against a throwaway jj repository.

verification.testName: finds item mentions without matching paths or longer words
closes only the items a magic word names
reads jj log records, skipping malformed ones
reads closing references from jj log with the shipped template
moves an item forward on a signal, records the link, and never moves it back
links but does not move an item whose status the user chose

features.title: Mention backlog items with @
features.summary: `@b:`/`@backlog:` lists backlog items in the composer's @ menu, plain @ adds up to five matches; a picked chip is sent as `b:<id> "title"`, which the thread signal turns into a link and a start.
failureModes: A failing search returns no backlog rows; the other @ groups are unaffected.
An invalid chip reference blocks the send instead of sending broken text.

verification.testName: lists the backlog alone under @b:, a few items under plain @, nothing under another scope
sends a chip as text naming b:<id>, so the thread signal sees it

features.title: Search with reasons and saved views
features.summary: Relevance-ranked search over titles, tags, descriptions, comments, original captures, projects and links, with kind/status/attention/tag/project/actor/link/recency operators; each result says where it matched. Views save a view and search to the plugin settings.
failureModes: A settings write that the Host refuses drops the optimistic saved view.

verification.testName: ranks a title hit above a comment hit and says where each matched
combines operators with free text
filters by recency and matches ids exactly

features.title: Attention Inbox across items and threads
features.summary: Items asking for input, blocked or waiting, items with a triage suggestion, and (setting inboxThreads) linked threads whose last turn was blocked or errored. Read state is separate from requiring action; snoozed items return later.
failureModes: Without thread-sidebar's attention API the Inbox shows backlog items only.

externalDependencies.boundary: Reads thread-sidebar-attention state and acknowledges a thread through its published contract.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: inboxThreadsFrom is unit-tested on fixed attention records in src/inbox-threads.test.ts.

verification.testName: keeps only failed turns of threads linked to an item by default
adds finished turns waiting for review in all mode, and nothing when off
puts an item asking for input in the Inbox, keeps it visible, and keeps it there once acknowledged
hides a snoozed item until its time, then lets it resurface

features.title: Backlog work in the Activity timeline
features.summary: Item creation, moves, links, comments, triage and requests for input are published as backlog.* events to @dshfiles/activity-timeline (setting publishActivity); the item log stays the source of truth and each item shows one condensed activity line.
failureModes: Without the timeline plugin the events have no listener and nothing changes.

externalDependencies.boundary: Emits the strict backlog payload of dshfiles/activity/event; the timeline validates it with backlogActivitySchema.

verification.testName: summarizes many agent updates as one activity line
stamps who made a link

features.title: A chat-sized capture box with files, properties and references
features.summary: The composer is a three-line card with a Linear-style toolbar: `+` adds an image or any file, links a backlog item or a thread, or sets a project; status and kind chips are editable before sending; images can be pasted, dropped or picked, are scaled in the browser, other files keep their bytes, and all are kept with the item; the microphone records through the Host voice-input bundle and inserts the transcript into the same draft. Images render as a thumbnail grid, other files as download rows, and feed cards show a paperclip count.
reach: click button "Add a file or a reference"
fill textbox "Capture" "rich capture with an image"
expect text "rich capture with an image"
click text "rich capture with an image"
failureModes: A file that is not a supported image, or one still larger than 8 MB after shrinking, is refused with the reason and the rest of the draft stays.
Voice input is disabled with a title when the browser has no speech recognizer.
A failed capture puts the text, images and properties back.

verification.testName: keeps images and files with an item, reads them back, and removes them
takes the kind, status and project the composer set, and records them as the user owns them

features.title: Start a thread from an item
features.summary: Right-clicking any item, feed entry or board card opens a dialog that picks the project (the item's own project preselected), the account/model and reasoning effort, and an opening message; starting it creates the thread, names it after the item, links the item to it and opens it, sending the message at once unless the setting or the dialog box asks for an editable draft.
failureModes: A thread the Host refuses is reported in the dialog and no item link is written.
A model switch that the Host rejects keeps the thread on the Host default model and still opens it.
An empty first message opens an empty thread instead of sending anything.
A blocked draft initialization leaves the thread open with an empty composer.

verification.testName: preselects the item project, a bare folder for an unregistered path, and the Host default without one
lists one row per provider and model so equal model ids stay distinct
opens with the item heading and appends the preview once
